label: Spikestem Grass Tree
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One independent square Glaze artwork with true transparent background. RASPNEST HEATH, a tangible heathland formed entirely from dry EXCELSIOR WOOD-WOOL sculpture. The reference is our own echidna artwork and is used ONLY to match physical material and lighting; create a wholly different subject. Many irregular thin FLAT brittle wood shavings, tangled ribbons and pointed splinters with longitudinal grain, fibrous fractured tips, subtle curved edges, open inter-strand gaps and compressed dense anatomical bundles. Natural pale honey, russet bark and smoky brown woods, matte and dry, diffuse studio macro lighting, convincing material depth. No smooth solid wooden core, polished carving, fur/plush, string/thread, woven fabric, wire, clay, paper quilling, rolled rosettes or concentric coils. Entire subject fits into central 70% with ample truly transparent space on every side; all tips, claws and foliage comfortably inside the image. No floor or shadow outside subject, panel, backing, atmosphere, frame, text, symbols, clock/battery/calendar or UI. Strong singular silhouette readable at85px. SUBJECT: one complete Australian-inspired GRASS-TREE, a stout charcoal-brown tapering trunk made of short darker shattered bark shavings, topped by a radiating fountain of very long narrow pointed pale-honey shaved-wood leaves. The foliage bends down at the ends in a loose spherical fountain; one single tall upright flower spike rises above it with dense little cream wood splinters at its tip. Include exposed low root toes and two tiny fallen seed pods beside the trunk. Strong upright botanical silhouette with a wide fine-leaf canopy and distinct tall spike. All leaf tips and spike comfortably inside the image. Not a palm tree, not a bird, no animals.
processing: Whole original uniformly contained within900px on transparent1024square, alpha preserved. No subject crop, recolour or artistic edits.

references.purpose: Own first artwork supplies the physical wood-shaving material and lighting only; new distinct subject.
